workflows.label: Scaffold
workflows.summary: Set up a new PDD project with folders, context stubs, and starter guidance.

workflows.label: Init
workflows.summary: Add PDD structure to an existing repository and infer a starting context.

workflows.label: Context
workflows.summary: Write or update the persistent project context files that future prompts depend on.

workflows.label: Research
workflows.summary: Explore the problem space, evaluate options, and decide what to build.

workflows.label: Plan
workflows.summary: Break a feature into phases and decide the prompt chain strategy before coding.

workflows.label: Prompts
workflows.summary: Generate focused feature prompts and place them in the right PDD folder.

workflows.label: Update
workflows.summary: Diagnose and improve a prompt that is producing weak or incorrect output.

workflows.label: Review
workflows.summary: Verify and review AI-generated output before it is committed.

workflows.label: Eval
workflows.summary: Track prompt quality over time with repeatable evaluation criteria.

workflows.label: Status
workflows.summary: Check what PDD artifacts exist, what is stale, and what to do next.

workflows.label: Help
workflows.summary: Show the available workflows, when to use them, and the typical sequence.
